title: 秋華賞の後に・アイツのいる場所へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon crushes it at the Shuka Sho, and the audience is abuzz with anticipation for a future showdown between her and the Beast, Narita Brian, who currently holds two Classic crowns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the post-race press conference, she challenges Narita Brian to a one-on-one at the upcoming Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian watches the broadcast in real time and laughs to herself, impressed—but not intimidated.
